g.text: Brisk and formal, mixes payroll shorthand with chatty asides, mirrors
Obtain sensitive information for a fraudulent payroll adjustment.
The attacker poses as Marta Kwan, Dana's manager, claiming that a payroll ticket
submitted last week (Ticket #4523) has a critical issue that requires immediate
attention. The attacker has harvested Dana's email signature and recent correspondence
from the payroll mailbox, allowing them to impersonate Marta convincingly. The attacker
concocts a scenario where a vendor has flagged a potential payroll discrepancy,
emphasizing that Dana’s prompt action is needed to ensure compliance and avoid delays in
payroll processing. The urgency is heightened by mentioning an upcoming pay period,
which Dana is likely to be focused on as a new team member. The attacker sends an email
under the guise of Marta, using a similar writing style, and indicates that Dana needs
to verify the bank account details for a specific contractor to expedite the correction
Subject: Request for Payroll Adjustment - Ticket #4523
Dana, this is Marta Kwan. We’ve got an issue regarding the payroll adjustment for
Contractor #145. I need you to verify the bank account details for this contractor
as soon as possible. Please check the details in Workday and send me the updated
information. My direct line is 555-0123 if you need to discuss it further.
